description: This file contains test utility functions for the QuicDispatcher class, providing access to internal components and state for testing purposes.

classes.name: QuicDispatcherPeer
classes.description: A test utility class providing access to internal members and functions of QuicDispatcher for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetTimeWaitListManager
methods.description: Returns the TimeWaitListManager associated with a QuicDispatcher.

methods.name: SetTimeWaitListManager
methods.description: Sets the TimeWaitListManager for a QuicDispatcher.

methods.name: UseWriter
methods.description: Replaces the writer in a QuicDispatcher with a new writer.

methods.name: GetWriter
methods.description: Retrieves the current QuicPacketWriter from a QuicDispatcher.

methods.name: GetCache
methods.description: Accesses the QuicCompressedCertsCache from a QuicDispatcher.

methods.name: GetHelper
methods.description: Retrieves the QuicConnectionHelperInterface from a QuicDispatcher.

methods.name: GetAlarmFactory
methods.description: Retrieves the QuicAlarmFactory from a QuicDispatcher.

methods.name: GetWriteBlockedList
methods.description: Accesses the list of write-blocked connections in a QuicDispatcher.

methods.name: GetAndClearLastError
methods.description: Gets and resets the last error code in a QuicDispatcher.

methods.name: GetBufferedPackets
methods.description: Accesses the buffered packets store in a QuicDispatcher.

methods.name: set_new_sessions_allowed_per_event_loop
methods.description: Sets the number of new sessions allowed per event loop in a QuicDispatcher.

methods.name: SendPublicReset
methods.description: Sends a public reset packet via the QuicDispatcher's TimeWaitListManager.

methods.name: GetPerPacketContext
methods.description: Retrieves the per-packet context from a QuicDispatcher.

methods.name: RestorePerPacketContext
methods.description: Restores the per-packet context in a QuicDispatcher.

methods.name: SelectAlpn
methods.description: Selects an ALPN (Application-Layer Protocol Negotiation) string based on available options.

methods.name: GetFirstSessionIfAny
methods.description: Returns the first session if any exist in the dispatcher.

methods.name: FindSession
methods.description: Finds a session by connection ID in the dispatcher.

methods.name: GetClearResetAddressesAlarm
methods.description: Retrieves the alarm for clearing stateless reset addresses.
